name: AlertDialog
description: Requests a required decision, focusing the safest answer and preventing dismissal by outside presses.

onOpenChange.description: Called when the open state changes; Escape and Cancel close it

when: Confirming a destructive or irreversible action
An authority action: activating workspace rules, granting an exception, a bypass
A choice that must be answered before work continues
whenNot: A notice the user does not answer (use Toast or Alert)
A reversible action (act, then offer undo in a Toast)
guidelines: Title asks the question; the description names the consequence
Two answers: AlertDialog.Cancel and one AlertDialog.Action whose label is the verb
Pass render={<Button />} to Cancel and Action; a destructive Action takes tone="danger"
Focus opens on Cancel; set initialFocus only when the safe answer lives elsewhere
An Action press in the first half second after opening is ignored, so the click or Return that opened the dialog cannot answer it
accessibility: role="alertdialog" labelled by AlertDialog.Title and described by AlertDialog.Description
Traps focus; focus opens on AlertDialog.Cancel and returns to the trigger
Escape closes; an outside press does not

examples.name: Default
examples.code:
<AlertDialog>
  <AlertDialog.Trigger render={<Button variant="soft" />}>Delete branch</AlertDialog.Trigger>
  <AlertDialog.Content>
    <AlertDialog.Header>
      <AlertDialog.Title>Delete the branch?</AlertDialog.Title>
      <AlertDialog.Description>Its 3 open findings close with it.</AlertDialog.Description>
    </AlertDialog.Header>
    <AlertDialog.Footer>
      <AlertDialog.Cancel render={<Button variant="ghost" />}>Cancel</AlertDialog.Cancel>
      <AlertDialog.Action render={<Button variant="solid" tone="danger" />}>Delete branch</AlertDialog.Action>
    </AlertDialog.Footer>
  </AlertDialog.Content>
</AlertDialog>

relations.note: Use Dialog for a task with fields or a long read
For a reversible action, act and offer undo in a Toast

propsSummary: AlertDialog.Content width: sm|md - sheet width (default: sm)
AlertDialog.Content initialFocus: boolean|ref|function - focus target on open (default: AlertDialog.Cancel)
AlertDialog.Content finalFocus: boolean|ref|function - focus target on close (default: true)
AlertDialog.Cancel: closes; takes focus on open
AlertDialog.Action onClick: runs, then closes; ignored for 500ms after opening
AlertDialog.Trigger, Cancel, Action render: element - render a library control
